program.name: Solanar Graduate Program
program.credential: Graduate Certificate of Completion in Numerical Weather Prediction & Data Assimilation
program.concentration: Computational Atmospheric Modeling · Ensembles · Data Assimilation · Hybrid AI/ML
program.prerequisite: Solanar Professional Meteorology Certificate Years I–II or equivalent university-level atmospheric science, calculus, physics, programming and statistics preparation.
program.credential_note: Internal Solanar/Khaemenes certificate of completion; not accredited university credit, government licensure, AMS certification, or a substitute for institutional degree requirements.

mathematics.name: Calculus II
mathematics.use: Integration, infinite series, parametric reasoning, differential-equation applications and continuous model formulation.

mathematics.name: Linear Algebra
mathematics.use: State vectors, matrices, least squares, eigenstructure, covariance, SVD, inverse problems and data assimilation.

mathematics.name: Differential Equations
mathematics.use: Atmospheric governing equations, systems, stability, numerical integration, oscillations and dynamical prediction.

mathematics.name: Statistics
mathematics.use: Probability, Bayesian foundations, estimation, regression, resampling, ensemble forecasting, calibration and verification.

mathematics.name: Introduction to Proofs
mathematics.use: Assumptions, formal reasoning, convergence arguments, defensible methods and research writing.

mathematics.name: Real & Complex Analysis
mathematics.use: Rigorous limits, convergence, continuity and advanced mathematical analysis for numerical-method research.
